name: Payroll / Compensation
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-031 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.

Slash-boundary hold: this aggregate covers payroll execution and compensation results, while compensation plans, agreements, equity administration and non-payroll rewards may require separate canonical models.
Relation hold: WM-ORG-005 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-031 edge.
Identity hold: payroll run, payee result, compensation term, time record, benefit, payment, statement, filing, remittance, ledger entry, dispute and records object remain distinct.
Class hold: regular, supplemental, off-cycle, final, advance, retroactive, correction, reversal and void processing require explicit classes and lineage.

Value hold: earning component, gross, taxable, pensionable and insurable bases, deductions, employer contributions, net pay, employer cost and statistical labour cost remain separately sourced and currency qualified.
Lifecycle hold: calculated, validated, approved, released, paid, settled, filed, accepted, reconciled and closed states do not prove one another.
Correction hold: retroactive adjustment, correction, reversal and void preserve originals and declare downstream obligations rather than overwriting history.
Privacy hold: worker identifiers, pay, bank, tax, benefit, garnishment, absence, performance and dispute data require purpose limitation, least privilege and minimum disclosure.
Source-access hold: ILO, US DOL, Canada CRA, Australia ATO, OECD and ISO sources had automated-access limitations or bounded timeouts and were verified through official indexed content.

Profile hold: employee, contractor, executive, equity, tips, piecework, commission, bonus, expense, household, agricultural, migrant, public-sector, multi-jurisdiction and multi-currency uses need separate profiles.

Interoperability hold: every labour, tax, payroll, payment, reporting, statistical, privacy, currency, temporal, provenance, quality, policy and API projection needs exact release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Review hold: payroll, compensation, labour, tax, benefits, garnishment, payments, accounting, privacy, audit and independent external review are outstanding.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
